title: Linear provider
desc:
Linear is the tracker many small product teams use instead of Jira, and workbench cannot read it. A team on Linear today has to copy each ticket into the local backlog by hand before triage-task can see it.

ACCEPTANCE:
- providers/linear.py subclasses Provider per docs/providers.md and is registered; keys are TEAM-123
- GraphQL API at api.linear.app; auth from a personal API key in the context, read from an env var, never logged or cached
- title, description, state, type from labels, comments newest-first and capped, history, and relations: blocks and blocked by map to the canonical set, related to relates, parent and sub-issues to hierarchy; anything else to other and _unmapped
- every request has a timeout and a bounded payload; pagination capped like the other providers; a rate-limit response surfaces as a clear error, not a retry storm
- cache revalidation uses updatedAt so an unchanged issue is not refetched
- fixtures under tests/fixtures/linear/ and the parity test runs it like the others
- wb init and wb doctor know the provider; docs/providers.md gains a section on what Linear has no equivalent for
